span.p:
THE CITATION GATE · chitragupta draft gate
Is every citekey in this draft present in the ledger?
run twice: by the PostToolUse hook on every write under content/drafts/,
and by the skill itself before it shows you anything

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REFUSED · exit 1
the write is blocked and the chain stops

div.style: color: rgb(66, 32, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.b: the skill fixes it and re-runs — itself
p.small:
“Fix and re-run until OK. Never present a draft that hasn't
passed.” — every SKILL.md carries this instruction.
It swaps the bad key for one retrieval actually returned, or drops
the claim. You are shown nothing until the gate is green.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.small:
IEEE ## References, numbered by first appearance,
built only from citekeys the draft actually cites.
Skipped for thesis .tex fragments, where the
surrounding LaTeX owns the bibliography.

span.p:
docling — reads the PDF itself, not content/parsed/
content/docling/<doc>.md — layout-aware text
<doc>.passages.json — the quotable-passage sidecar
<doc>_artifacts/ — figure bitmaps, written by Docling
<doc>.figures.json — page, caption, cite string per figure
the last two only when [enrich].docling_images is on
